note: Off I-75 Exit 32 at Cecil, north of Valdosta. Clubhouse and meeting space, cable TV, private fishing ponds on the property. --Claude
summary: Read cecilbayrv.com (home, rates, amenities): confirmed $50 nightly incl. taxes ($45 Good Sam; at the $50 line, passes), 100 pull-through sites, 30/50 A full hookups; added Good Sam discount (operator-stated), facilities (showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, dump), phone booking, sites note (75-ft sites). Pin is on the RV loops. Fishing ponds are ~100 m north of the sites, not a waterfront lead. Note cleaned.
flags: Price at the gate: operator posts exactly $50 (taxes included). One RV Life reviewer reported paying $75 with Good Sam in October 2026; others in 2025-2026 paid $36-50. If $75 is a current or event rate it would fail the $50 gate (no gateway within 40 km); the operator's page still says $50.

Reviewers (2026) describe weeds, junk around the office and maintenance needed; operator offers weekly/monthly rates and 'extended stay', but reviews describe it as an overnight stop, not a resident park.
